description: The identical function RETURNING the keywordless binding it declared. Read or unread, no E-MU-001: an unread binding is the S422 unused-binding lint (see linear/must-use-unread-pos), and a read one is not even that.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S479-3B · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S422 "CALL 3 — unused-binding is a LINT across all binding forms"
rationale: §50.8.5: the keywordless statement `x = value` declares `x` exactly as `const x = value` does; E-MU-001 is "Must-use: return value of `!` function not captured" (§34), not an unread-binding code (S479 §3.B ruling).
